title: Gerundio: posición social indígena y afrodescendiente

sections.content: An opening gerund can describe the motive or method behind an action (buscando proteger, buscando aprovechar) or introduce the analytical move a paragraph is making (comparando, resistiendo). These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Buscando en teoría 'protegerlos', la corona clasificó a los indígenas legalmente casi como menores de edad permanentes.
items.english: Seeking, in theory, to 'protect' them, the crown classified indigenous people legally as almost permanent legal minors.

items.spanish: Buscando aprovechar cualquier vía de movilidad disponible, muchos hombres libres se alistaron en milicias locales.
items.english: Seeking to take advantage of any available path to mobility, many free men enlisted in local militias.

items.spanish: Resistiendo militarmente los intentos españoles de reconquistarlo, San Basilio de Palenque logró un reconocimiento formal de su libertad.
items.english: Militarily resisting Spanish attempts to reconquer it, San Basilio de Palenque achieved formal recognition of its freedom.

items.spanish: Comparando ambas experiencias, resulta evidente que ninguna encajaba en una sola categoría de 'oprimidos'.
items.english: Comparing both experiences, it becomes clear that neither fit into a single category of 'the oppressed'.

sections.content: Buscando + infinitive (buscando proteger, buscando aprovechar) is a common way to state a goal or intention behind an action — it answers "with what aim?" the same way an opening gerund usually answers "how?" or "while doing what?"
